channel.title: Cyber Threat Wall — Latest Movers
channel.description: Actively exploited vulnerabilities rising fastest in Cyber Threat Wall rankings.

item.title: CVE-2025-25249 — Fortinet Multiple Products
item.description: Threat Signal 65. Fortinet FortiOS, FortiSwitchManager, and FortiSASE contain a heap-based buffer overflow vulnerability that allows an attacker to execute unauthorized code or commands via specially crafted packets.

item.title: CVE-2026-75650 — Adobe Commerce and Magento
item.description: Threat Signal 65. Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source contain an improper neutralization of special elements used in a template engine vulnerability that could allow an attacker to execute arbitrary code.

item.title: CVE-2026-64849 — MLflow MLflow
item.description: Threat Signal 65. MLflow contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability that can allow attackers to reach internal or cloud metadata services and receive response_status and response_body.

item.title: CVE-2026-50522 — Microsoft SharePoint
item.description: Threat Signal 65. Microsoft SharePoint contains a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability which could allow an unauthorized attacker to execute code over a network.

item.title: CVE-2026-56291 — Balbooa Forms
item.description: Threat Signal 65. Balbooa Forms contains an unrestricted upload of file with dangerous type vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated arbitrary file upload which could allow uploading of executable files leading to full RCE.

item.title: CVE-2025-67038 — Lantronix EDS5000
item.description: Threat Signal 65. Lantronix EDS5000 contains a code injection vulnerability that could allow attackers to inject arbitrary OS commands into the username parameter. Injected commands are executed with root privileges.

item.title: CVE-2026-34908 — Ubiquiti UniFi OS
item.description: Threat Signal 65. Ubiquiti UniFi OS contains an improper access control vulnerability which could allow a malicious actor with access to the network to make unauthorized changes to the system.

item.title: CVE-2026-48907 — Widget Factory Joomla Content Editor
item.description: Threat Signal 65. Widget Factory Joomla Content Editor contains an improper access control vulnerability which could allow for upload and execution of PHP code via the creation of new editor profiles for unauthenticated users.

item.title: CVE-2026-9082 — Drupal Core
item.description: Threat Signal 65. Drupal Core contains a SQL injection vulnerability that could allow for privilege escalation and remote code execution via specially crafted requests sent with the database abstraction API.

item.title: CVE-2026-22769 — Dell RecoverPoint for Virtual Machines (RP4VMs)
item.description: Threat Signal 65. Dell RecoverPoint for Virtual Machines (RP4VMs) contains an use of hard-coded credentials vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated remote attacker to gain unauthorized access to the underlying operating system and root-level persistence.

item.title: CVE-2026-21510 — Microsoft Windows
item.description: Threat Signal 65. Microsoft Windows Shell contains a protection mechanism failure vulnerability that could allow an unauthorized attacker to bypass a security feature over a network.

item.title: CVE-2018-4063 — Sierra Wireless AirLink ALEOS
item.description: Threat Signal 65. Sierra Wireless AirLink ALEOS contains an unrestricted upload of file with dangerous type vulnerability. A specially crafted HTTP request can upload a file, resulting in executable code being uploaded, and routable, to the webserver. An attacker can make an authenticated HTTP request to trigger this vulnerability. The impacted product could be end-of-life (EoL) and/or end-of-service (EoS). Users should discontinue product utilization.

item.title: CVE-2025-54948 — Trend Micro Apex One
item.description: Threat Signal 65. Trend Micro Apex One Management Console (on-premise) contains an OS command injection vulnerability that could allow a pre-authenticated remote attacker to upload malicious code and execute commands on affected installations.

item.title: CVE-2022-40799 — D-Link DNR-322L
item.description: Threat Signal 65. D-Link DNR-322L contains a download of code without integrity check vulnerability that could allow an authenticated attacker to execute OS level commands on the device. The impacted products could be end-of-life (EoL) and/or end-of-service (EoS). Users should discontinue product utilization.

item.title: CVE-2025-4632 — Samsung MagicINFO 9 Server
item.description: Threat Signal 65. Samsung MagicINFO 9 Server contains a path traversal vulnerability that allows an attacker to write arbitrary file as system authority.

item.title: CVE-2023-20118 — Cisco Small Business RV Series Routers
item.description: Threat Signal 65. Multiple Cisco Small Business RV Series Routers contains a command injection vulnerability in the web-based management interface. Successful exploitation could allow an authenticated, remote attacker to gain root-level privileges and access unauthorized data.

item.title: CVE-2024-43573 — Microsoft Windows
item.description: Threat Signal 65. Microsoft Windows MSHTML Platform contains an unspecified spoofing vulnerability which can lead to a loss of confidentiality.

item.title: CVE-2021-31196 — Microsoft Exchange Server
item.description: Threat Signal 65. Microsoft Exchange Server contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows for remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2014-100005 — D-Link DIR-600 Router
item.description: Threat Signal 65. D-Link DIR-600 routers contain a cross-site request forgery (CSRF) vulnerability that allows an attacker to change router configurations by hijacking an existing administrator session.

item.title: CVE-2023-43770 — Roundcube Webmail
item.description: Threat Signal 65. Roundcube Webmail contains a persistent cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability that can lead to information disclosure via malicious link references in plain/text messages.

item.title: CVE-2023-36874 — Microsoft Windows
item.description: Threat Signal 65. Microsoft Windows Error Reporting Service contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for privilege escalation.

item.title: CVE-2022-4135 — Google Chromium GPU
item.description: Threat Signal 65. Google Chromium GPU contains a heap buffer overflow vulnerability that allows a remote attacker, who has compromised the renderer process, to potentially perform a sandbox escape via a crafted HTML page. This vulnerability could affect multiple web browsers that utilize Chromium, including, but not limited to, Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, and Opera.

item.title: CVE-2021-38163 — SAP NetWeaver
item.description: Threat Signal 65. SAP NetWeaver contains a vulnerability that allows unrestricted file upload.

item.title: CVE-2018-4990 — Adobe Acrobat and Reader
item.description: Threat Signal 65. Adobe Acrobat and Reader have a double free vulnerability that could lead to remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2018-17480 — Google Chromium V8
item.description: Threat Signal 65. Google Chromium V8 Engine contains out-of-bounds write vulnerability that allows a remote attacker to execute code inside a sandbox via a crafted HTML page. This vulnerability could affect multiple web browsers that utilize Chromium, including, but not limited to, Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, and Opera.

item.title: CVE-2016-5198 — Google Chromium V8
item.description: Threat Signal 65. Google Chromium V8 Engine contains an out-of-bounds memory access vulnerability that allows a remote attacker to perform read/write operations, leading to code execution, via a crafted HTML page. This vulnerability could affect multiple web browsers that utilize Chromium, including, but not limited to, Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, and Opera.

item.title: CVE-2013-3896 — Microsoft Silverlight
item.description: Threat Signal 65. Microsoft Silverlight does not properly validate pointers during access to Silverlight elements, which allows remote attackers to obtain sensitive information via a crafted Silverlight application.

item.title: CVE-2018-19943 — QNAP Network Attached Storage (NAS)
item.description: Threat Signal 65. A cross-site scripting vulnerability affecting QNAP NAS File Station could allow remote attackers to inject malicious code.

item.title: CVE-2019-5786 — Google Chrome Blink
item.description: Threat Signal 65. Google Chrome Blink contains a heap use-after-free vulnerability that allows an attacker to potentially perform out of bounds memory access via a crafted HTML page.

item.title: CVE-2015-1770 — Microsoft Office
item.description: Threat Signal 65. Microsoft Office allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code via a crafted Office document.

item.title: CVE-2021-41379 — Microsoft Windows
item.description: Threat Signal 65. Microsoft Windows Installer contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for privilege escalation.

item.title: CVE-2015-2590 — Oracle Java SE
item.description: Threat Signal 65. An unspecified vulnerability exists within Oracle Java Runtime Environment that allows an attacker to perform remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2020-13671 — Drupal Drupal core
item.description: Threat Signal 65. Improper sanitization in the extension file names is present in Drupal core.

item.title: CVE-2021-42292 — Microsoft Office
item.description: Threat Signal 65. A security feature bypass vulnerability in Microsoft Excel would allow a local user to perform arbitrary code execution.

item.title: CVE-2020-5735 — Amcrest Cameras and Network Video Recorder (NVR)
item.description: Threat Signal 65. Amcrest cameras and NVR contain a stack-based buffer overflow vulnerability through port 37777 that allows an unauthenticated, remote attacker to crash the device and possibly execute code.

item.title: CVE-2021-30657 — Apple macOS
item.description: Threat Signal 65. Apple macOS contains an unspecified logic issue in System Preferences that may allow a malicious application to bypass Gatekeeper checks.

item.title: CVE-2021-37975 — Google Chromium V8
item.description: Threat Signal 65. Google Chromium V8 Engine contains a use-after-free vulnerability that allows a remote attacker to potentially exploit heap corruption via a crafted HTML page. This vulnerability could affect multiple web browsers that utilize Chromium, including, but not limited to, Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, and Opera.

item.title: CVE-2020-1054 — Microsoft Win32k
item.description: Threat Signal 65. Microsoft Win32k contains a privilege escalation vulnerability when the Windows kernel-mode driver fails to properly handle objects in memory. Successful exploitation allows an attacker to execute code in kernel mode.

item.title: CVE-2016-3235 — Microsoft Office
item.description: Threat Signal 65. Microsoft Office Object Linking & Embedding (OLE) dynamic link library (DLL) contains a side loading vulnerability due to it improperly validating input before loading libraries. Successful exploitation allows for remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2017-16651 — Roundcube Roundcube Webmail
item.description: Threat Signal 65. Roundcube Webmail contains a file disclosure vulnerability caused by insufficient input validation in conjunction with file-based attachment plugins, which are used by default.

item.title: CVE-2017-6327 — Symantec Symantec Messaging Gateway
item.description: Threat Signal 65. Symantec Messaging Gateway contains an unspecified vulnerability which can allow for remote code execution. With the ability to perform remote code execution, an attacker may also desire to perform privilege escalating actions.

item.title: CVE-2026-86950 — Apple Multiple Products
item.description: Threat Signal 64. Apple iOS, macOS, and iPadOS contain an out-of-bounds write vulnerability in CoreGraphics that may lead to arbitrary code execution.

item.title: CVE-2026-42018 — JFrog Artifactory
item.description: Threat Signal 64. JFrog Artifactory contains an improper authentication vulnerability that could return an internal anonymous-user token to an unauthenticated caller when anonymous access is disabled, potentially exposing sensitive resources.

item.title: CVE-2026-49869 — Kestra Kestra OSS
item.description: Threat Signal 64. Kestra OSS contains an OS command injection vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated remote attacker to create and execute arbitrary workflows without credentials.

item.title: CVE-2026-33824 — Microsoft Internet Key Exchange (IKE) Service Extensions
item.description: Threat Signal 64. Microsoft Internet Key Exchange (IKE) Service Extensions contains a double free vulnerability that could enable remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2026-65400 — Apple macOS
item.description: Threat Signal 64. Apple macOS contains an improper authentication vulnerability that could allow an attacker on the network to authenticate to Screen Sharing without valid credentials.

item.title: CVE-2026-16812 — Arista VeloCloud Orchestrator
item.description: Threat Signal 64. Arista VeloCloud Orchestrator On-Prem contains an OS command injection vulnerability that may allow a remote attacker to access privileged internal functionality and impact the VCO host. Successful exploitation may compromise the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of the orchestrator and data managed by the orchestrator.

item.title: CVE-2026-46817 — Oracle E-Business Suite
item.description: Threat Signal 64. Oracle E-Business Suite contains an improper privilege management vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated attacker with network access via HTTP to compromise Oracle Payments. Successful attacks of this vulnerability can result in takeover of Oracle Payments.

item.title: CVE-2026-56164 — Microsoft SharePoint Server
item.description: Threat Signal 64. Microsoft SharePoint contains a missing authentication for critical function vulnerability that allows an unauthorized attacker to elevate privileges over a network.

item.title: CVE-2026-32201 — Microsoft SharePoint Server
item.description: Threat Signal 64. Microsoft SharePoint Server contains an improper input validation vulnerability that allows an unauthorized attacker to perform spoofing over a network.
